scope: Local P4 allocation repair and measured remaining-pass evaluation; no qualification
allocation_acceptance: Identical scientific outputs/solver work; zero real allocator events in the 16-iteration window, stable capacities, unchanged admission. No command gain required for allocation contract repair; report paired times and memory.
norm_prototype: Only adopt a separately isolated subsequent norm/mean scheduling change with exact values, no additional observation workspace and at least 3% primary command gain.
controls: Review slowdowns exceeding max(10 ms, 5%); include QR fallback, low/small, weak graphs and relevant weight/covariance/output cases. Repeat flagged controls.
